summary: Collision response dispatch: when the sensor float at this+0x71 is below a2+4, or the XOR of the flag byte at this+0x70 with a2+3 has any of bits 0-2 set, routes to VehicleOrientationFromEulerAngles (type field 7) or ArithmeticComparison_3a90 (type field 0) based on the collision-type field in a2, then clears 104 per-byte bit flags with BitFlagSetter. Called from sub_465300.

operations.description: Enter the response body when float at this+0x71 < float at a2+4, or when (byte at this+0x70 XOR byte at a2+3) AND 7 is non-zero.
Extract the collision-type field from a2: (a2 >> 18) AND 0x3F.
Only dispatch when the collision-type field is non-zero.
Type field value 7 selects the Euler-angle orientation path.
When the type field equals 7, set vehicle orientation from the Euler angles at this+109 using the float at a2+4.
When the type field is zero, run the arithmetic comparison operation on a2.
Loop over 104 consecutive flag bytes beginning at this.
Clear each flag byte in the 104-byte range via BitFlagSetter(this + i, 0).
Return the XOR comparison value computed by the guard (result).

unresolved: Meaning of the collision-type field ((a2 >> 18) & 0x3F) and its values 0 and 7 is not established.
What the 104 per-byte bit flags at this represent is unknown.
Which bits BitFlagSetter clears (flag argument 0) is not resolved here.
